titulo: The pen back in its cup
caption:
The pen rolled off the desk twice this week. Today it went back in its cup.

A pen with a home is found in one glance, and a pen without one is found never.

For whoever puts the pen back in its cup after using it.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table, a blue pen lying flat at the middle and a big cream mug with a terracotta band on the right. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and the pen hops in an arc and drops into the mug, standing upright with its tip above the rim. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me, pen back in its cup.
